### Equally Yoked - Today's Insight - July 5, 2022
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-july-5-2022.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 6:14
Points:
- Paul uses an agricultural illustration where harnessing unequal animals limits the stronger one's ability to work.
- In marriage, significant differences in character drag down and restrict both partners.
- An exceptional woman flourishes when matched with a secure, generous husband who affirms her abilities.
- A supportive partner transforms demanding family roles from exhausting toil into a joyful calling.
